background_story: Deep in the ocean, Twinkle the scaphopod lived a tranquil life in the soft, sandy seafloor. Her shell, shaped like a delicate tusk, glimmered with a soft, ethereal light, earning her the name Twinkle. As a scaphopod, she spent her days slowly burrowing into the sediment, filtering tiny particles for food. Despite her slow pace, Twinkle had a unique gift – she could sense the subtlest vibrations in the ocean currents. This allowed her to detect the faint hum of a school of plankton, guiding her to the best feeding grounds. Twinkle's gentle nature and remarkable sensitivity made her a beloved figure among the ocean's creatures, who would often gather around her to listen to the whispers of the sea.
